text.description_html:
RK International CK-322, Fancy Floral White Porcelain Cabinet Knob

Highlight your funky retro flair with this Flower Porcelain Cabinet Knob made by RK International. The shape is reminiscent of the 1960's; and the gold detailing ramp up the glitz and glamor of this white porcelain knob. The base is available in polished brass, satin nickel, and oil rubbed bronze.

Also Available Matching CP-352 White Porcelain Flower Cabinet Pull with Brass Lines

Specifications and Features of the RK International CK-322 Porcelain Floral Cabinet Hardware:

  • Material: porcelain with some brass
  • Diameter: 1-1/4"
  • Projection: 9/16"
  • Screw: 1" long #8 - 32 machine screw.
  • Packaged with all necessary installation hardware.

Sold Individually
